INSERT INTO stellar_user_behavior (user_id, device_id, event_type, spu_id, sku_id, category_id, keyword, scene, position, amount, duration_ms, extra, client_ip, user_agent, event_time) VALUES
(#{b.userId}, #{b.deviceId}, #{b.eventType}, #{b.spuId}, #{b.skuId}, #{b.categoryId}, #{b.keyword}, #{b.scene}, #{b.position}, #{b.amount}, #{b.durationMs}, #{b.extra}, #{b.clientIp}, #{b.userAgent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, device_id, spu_id, event_type, LEFT(keyword, 100) AS keyword, scene, LEFT(extra, 1200) AS extra, category_id, event_time FROM stellar_user_behavior WHERE (user_id IS NOT NULL OR (device_id IS NOT NULL AND device_id <> '')) AND ( (spu_id IS NOT NULL AND event_type IN ('view_item', 'add_to_cart', 'favorite', 'order_placed')) OR (event_type = 'search' AND keyword IS NOT NULL AND keyword <> '') OR (event_type = 'view_item_list' AND extra IS NOT NULL AND (extra LIKE '%itemIds%' OR extra LIKE '%spuIds%')) ) AND event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY user_id ASC, event_time ASC, id ASC
